name: Greatest power among the battlefield's and the graveyard's, and an activated base P/T stays the ability's
notes: Skanos Dragonheart attacks: it gets +X/+X, X the greatest power among other Dragons you control and Dragon cards in your graveyard. Shivan Dragon (5/5) on the battlefield, Furnace Whelp (2/2) and Charcoal Diamond (no Dragon) in your graveyard: X = 5, the greater; Skanos 9/9 (the fired "it" is picked as Skanos). Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse's activated "creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X" is no static effect of the card: unfired, Grizzly Bears stays 2/2.
